wording.title: Invitation presets
wording.intro: One preset can cover many honorifics. Honorifics that are not assigned, or left blank, use the default preset. Recipient names come from the guest list.
wording.saved: Invitation wording draft saved. Publish the invitation to update it for guests.
wording.invalid: Check the names, wording and honorifics. The wording must include {{label}} or {{name}}, and only supported variables can be used.
